intro.title: What does Exyconn build for startups and SaaS companies?
intro.definition: is a set of agents that run the repeatable parts of a software business around the product (onboarding, first-line support, lead qualification, dunning and churn watch) and, when you want it, AI features inside the product itself. Exyconn designs, builds and runs them on your helpdesk, CRM, billing system and product analytics, so a small team can serve many more customers. Founders and engineers stay on the roadmap.

messages.text: How do I import our customers from a spreadsheet?

props.label: The reality
props.title: Where a SaaS team's hours actually go
props.lede: Ask any founder where the week went. The answer is rarely the product.

items.title: Sign-ups who never activate
items.text: People create an account, get stuck on the first import or integration, and leave without telling anyone why.

items.title: "How do I" tickets
items.text: A large part of the support queue is answered in the docs. Engineers still get pulled in because the person on support isn't sure.

items.title: Demos with the wrong people
items.text: Founders spend calendar time on demos for students, competitors and companies far too small for the product, while real buyers wait days for a slot.

items.title: Churn nobody chose
items.text: A card expires or a bank declines a renewal, the reminder email lands in spam, and an account that was happy gets cancelled.

items.title: Accounts that go quiet
items.text: Logins drop and a key user leaves, but the warning sits in product analytics nobody checks until the renewal call.

items.title: An AI feature stuck on the roadmap
items.text: Customers ask for summaries, search or an assistant in the product. The team knows it matters but can't pause the core roadmap to learn how to build it safely.

offerings.title: Six jobs AI takes off your team's plate

items.title: In-app support and onboarding
items.text: A chat agent inside your app that knows the user's plan and setup, walks them through first steps, can make safe changes for them and opens a helpdesk ticket with context when it can't help.

items.title: Lead qualification and demo booking
items.text: Asks sign-ups and website visitors the questions your sales team would ask, enriches the lead in your CRM, and books a demo only for those who fit. Everyone else gets a self-serve path.

items.title: Answers from your docs
items.text: Searches your help centre, API reference, changelog and past tickets and answers with links to the source. Gaps in the docs are listed for whoever owns them.

items.title: Billing and failed-payment recovery
items.text: Reads failed charges from Stripe, Razorpay or Chargebee, messages the customer with a payment or mandate link on the right channel, answers invoice questions and tells finance what is recovered.

items.title: Product usage and churn signals
items.text: Watches logins, feature usage and seat changes per account, flags accounts that are going quiet and drafts a note for the account owner with what changed.

items.title: AI features inside your product
items.text: We design and build AI features your customers use, such as an assistant, summaries, smart search or extraction, with evaluation, cost limits and logging in place before release.

props.label: A day with it running
props.title: One day at a 15-person B2B SaaS startup
props.lede: Follow a weekday at a company selling to customers in India and abroad. Each moment lights the part of the business the agent is working on.

moments.title: Overnight payments followed up
moments.text: Six renewals failed overnight, two because card mandates need re-authorising. Each customer gets a message with the right link, and four are paid by lunch.

moments.title: A new admin set up in minutes
moments.text: A customer's ops lead signs in for the first time. The in-app agent helps her import 3,000 contacts, creates two missing fields and invites her team.

moments.title: An API question answered from the docs
moments.text: A developer asks how webhook retries work. The agent answers from the API reference with a link, and notes that the retry limit is missing from the docs.

moments.title: Only the right demos booked
moments.text: Twelve sign-ups answer a few questions about team size and use case. Three fit and are booked onto the founder's calendar with notes; the rest get a guided trial.

moments.title: A beta AI feature checked
moments.text: The summaries feature built last month has run on 400 customer records today. The evaluation report shows quality and cost per call, and one prompt is adjusted.

moments.title: Accounts going quiet, named
moments.text: Two accounts' weekly active users have halved and one admin has left. The account owner wakes up to a short note on each with the usage behind it.

items.question: Does this replace our support or success team?
items.answer: No. It takes how-to questions, setup help and payment follow-ups. Bugs, refunds, enterprise accounts and unhappy customers go to your team with the conversation and account details attached.

items.question: Which tools can it connect to?
items.answer: Helpdesks such as Zendesk, Intercom and Freshdesk, CRMs such as HubSpot and Salesforce, billing on Stripe, Razorpay or Chargebee, and product analytics tools, plus your own API. We confirm the exact access needed in the first week.

items.question: Can the agent change things in a customer's account?
items.answer: Only the actions you allow, through your own API and the user's permissions, such as adding a field or resending an invite. Anything destructive, billing changes and refunds need a person's approval, and every action is logged.

items.question: Can it handle customers in other languages?
items.answer: Yes. It replies in the language the user writes in, while your docs stay in English. For Indian customers that includes Hindi and other Indian languages.

items.question: What about customer data and security reviews?
items.answer: Customer data stays in your stack or an environment set up for you, with per-tenant isolation, role-based access and an audit log, and is not used to train shared models. The setup follows India's DPDP Act 2023 and the GDPR, and we help answer the security questionnaires your customers send.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on the use cases, the tools we connect and conversation volume. Most teams start with one agent at a fixed price for the first phase, and model usage is reported so you can see cost per conversation. Tell us about your product and we'll quote it.
